content.text: {"judgements":[{"id":"row0-ilo0-contentilo","label":"NOT_ALIGNED","explanation":"The target ILO asks students to demonstrate Augustinian, Marian and missionary Christ-centered Spirituality through value webbing. The source Week 1 content is only a course orientation (introduction to contents, requirements, objectives, grading and policies). It teaches nothing about Augustinian-Marian spirituality or value webbing, so students cannot reach the ILO from this content. Demonstrating a spirituality is also a higher-level performance than orientation content can teach. The ILO is not drawn from this week's content; and its wording is also not observable as written, because 'demonstrate spirituality' gives no concrete performance.
